responsibility: Implements GIMPLE/SSA-based array bounds diagnostics for -Warray-bounds. It walks reachable basic blocks in dominator order, queries value ranges and pointer/object information through range_query and pointer_query, analyzes ARRAY_REF, MEM_REF, and related address expressions against static and inferred object sizes (including flexible and trailing arrays), and emits warnings plus explanatory notes when a reference is proven below or above valid bounds while suppressing duplicate downstream diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Defines the array-bounds checker implementation and warning traversal logic: it walks reachable CFG blocks in dominator order and performs the actual ARRAY_REF/MEM_REF/ADDR_EXPR analysis and diagnostics, whereas the header only declares the array_bounds_checker class interface and its members.
